verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              प्रयाणे च ततः कर्णो हर्षयन्वाहिनीं तव । एकैकं समरे दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवान्पर्यपृच्छत ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said After Karna, gladdening your army, had started for battle he addressed to every Pandava soldier he met with these harsh words.

verses.sanskrit: यो मामद्य महात्मानं दर्शयेच्छ्वेतवाहनम् । तस्मै दद्यामभिप्रेतं धनं यन्मनसेच्छति ॥२॥
verses.english: I shall give him whatever riches he will want who will point out to me today the highsouled (Arjuna) of white horses.

verses.sanskrit: न चेत्तद‌भिमन्येत तस्मै दद्यामहं पुनः । शकटं रत्नसंपूर्णं यो मे ब्रूयाद्धनञ्जयम् ॥३॥
verses.english: I shall further more confer upon him, if he is not satisfied, a cart-load of jewels who will tell me where Dhananjaya is.

verses.sanskrit: न चेत्तद‌भिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् । शतं दद्यां गवां तस्मै नैत्यकं कांस्यदोहनम् ॥४॥
verses.english: If the person who will point out Arjuna be not contented with it, I shall give him a hundred kine with an equal number of brass vessels for milching them.

verses.sanskrit: शतं ग्रामवरांश्चैव दद्यामर्जुनदर्शिने । तथा तस्मै पुनर्दद्यां श्वेतमश्वतरीरथम् ॥५॥
verses.english: I will confer one hundred prosperous villages upon the man who will find out Arjuna for w. I will also give him who will point out Arjuna a number of damsels having long tresses and black eyes and a car drawn by white mules.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तमञ्जनकेशीभिर्यो मे ब्रूयाद्धनञ्जयम् । न चेत्तद‌भिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनद‌र्शिवान् ॥६॥
अन्यं वाऽस्मै पुनर्दद्यां सौवर्णं हस्तिषड्गवम् । तथाप्यस्मै पुनर्दद्यां स्त्रीणां शतमलङ्कृतम् ॥७॥
verses.english: If the person, who will point out Arjuna, be not contented with it I shall give him another best of cars made of gold and drawn by six bulls as large as elephants. I shall furthermore confer upon him one hundred well-adorned females wearing golden necklaces, fair and accomplished in singing and dancing.

verses.sanskrit: श्यामानां निष्ककण्ठीनां गीतवाद्यविपश्चिताम् । न चेत्तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् ॥८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: हस्तिषङ्गवं इस्तिषट्कं ‘हस्तिषङ्गवमिच्छन्ति वीराः षट्के च दन्तिनाम्’ इति प्राञ्चः । अन्यं वा सौवर्णरथमिति शेषः । हस्तितुल्याः षट् ‌गाव उक्षाणो यस्मिन् तं षट् हस्तिन एव गोवत् वोढारो यस्य तादृशम् ॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै दद्याञ्शतं नागान् शतं ग्रामाञ्शतं रथान् । सुवर्णस्य च मुख्यस्य हयाग्र्याणां शतं शतान् ॥९॥
verses.english: If the person, who will point out Arjuna, be not contented with it I shall give him a hundred clephants, a hundred villages, a hundred golden cars, ten thousand horses of most superior breed, fat, docile, gifted with other qualities, capable of dragging cars and well-trained.

verses.sanskrit: ऋद्ध्या गुणैः सुदान्तांश्च धुर्यवाहान्सुशिक्षितान् । तथा सुवर्णशृङ्गीणां गोधेनूनां चतुःशतम् ॥१०॥
दद्यां तस्मै सवत्सानां यो मे ब्रूयाद्धनञ्जयम् । न चेत्त‌दभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् ॥११॥
verses.english: I shall also give the person who will point out Arjuna four hundred kine, each with golden horns and her calf.
verses.bhavadeepa: ऋद्ध्या पुष्ट्या । सुदान्तान् विनीतान् । धुर्यवाहान् रथोद्वहनक्षमान् ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: अन्यदस्मै वरं दद्यां श्वेतान् पञ्चशतान् हयान् । हेमभाण्डपरिच्छन्नान्सुमृष्टमणिभूषणान् ॥१२॥
verses.english: If the person, who will find out Arjuna for me, be not satisfied with it i shall give him a more valuable present, namely five hundred horses-with gold trappings and jewelled ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: सुदान्तानपि चैवाहं दद्यामष्टाद‌शापरान् । रथं च शुभ्रं सौवर्णं दद्यां तस्मै सलङ्कृतम् ॥१३॥
verses.english: I shall also give him eighteen other tame horses. I shall give him, who will point out Arjuna to me, a golden car adorned with various ornaments and drawn by best Kamboja horses.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तं परमकाम्बोजैर्यो मे ब्रूयाद्धनञ्जयम् । न चेत्त‌दभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् ॥१४॥
अन्यदस्मै वरं दद्यां कुञ्जराणां शतानि षट् । काञ्चनैर्विविधैर्भाण्डैराच्छन्नान् हेममालिनः ॥१५॥
verses.english: If the person showing Arjuna to me considers it again inchoate reward, I will give him some more precious wealth. I will offer him six hundred elephants decorated with different gold ornaments and garlands who have born in the western border of India and suffice training given by the expert Mahavatas.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नानपरान्तेषु विनीतान् हस्तिशिक्षकैः । न चेत्तद‌भिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् ॥१६॥
अन्यदस्मै वरं दद्यां वैश्यग्रामांश्चतुर्दश । सुस्फीतान् धनसंयुक्तान् प्रत्यासन्नवनोदकान् ॥१७॥
verses.english: In case that person still considers it inchoate reward, I will give him another wealth more previous than the above. I will grant him ownership of fourteen prosperous and fertile villages equipped with facilities of water and forest in adjacent areas and where fear and discomfort any kind is not existed. These fourteen villages will prosperous and filled with kingly luxuries.

verses.sanskrit: अकुतोभयान् सुसंपन्नान् राजभोज्यांश्चतुर्दश । दासीनां निष्ककण्ठीनां मागधीनां शतं तथा । प्रत्यग्रवयसां दद्यां यो मे बूयाद्धनञ्जयम् ॥१८॥
verses.english: I will offer in gift on hundred young maids from Magadha state, well dressed and with gold garlands to the man who will tell me whereabouts of Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: न चेत्तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान् । अन्यं तस्मै वरं दद्यां यमसौ कामयेत्स्वयम् ॥१९॥
पुत्र-दारान्विहारांश्च यदन्यद्वित्तमस्ति मे । तच्च तस्मै पुनर्दद्यां यद्यच्च मनसेच्छति ॥२०॥
verses.english: I will give him all that wished by him and had in my possession whether wife, son, the garden and parks including clubs and whatever is with me in term of wealth and prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा च सहितौ कृष्णौ तयोर्वित्तानि सर्वशः । तस्मै दद्यामहं यो मे प्रब्रूयात्केशवार्जुनौ ॥२१॥
verses.english: I shall give him who will find out Keshava and Arjuna all the riches that will be left by them after slaying these two.

verses.sanskrit: एता वाचः सुबहुशः कर्ण उच्चारयन् युधि । दध्मौ सागरसंभूतं सुस्वरं शङ्खमुत्तमम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Having expressed himself thus in the battle Karna blew his excellent conch sea-born and making sweet blare.

verses.sanskrit: ता वाचः सूतपुत्रस्य तथा युक्ता निशम्य तु । दुर्योधनो महाराज संहृष्टः सानुगोऽभवत् ॥२३॥
verses.english: Hearing the words of the charioteer's son, which seemed proper to him, the great king Duryodhana, with all his followers, became filled with delight.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुंदुभिनिर्घोषो मृदङ्गानां च सर्वशः । सिंहनादः सवादित्रः कुञ्जराणां च निःस्वनः ॥२४॥
verses.english: Then there arose in the midst of the army, O king, O foremost, of men, the beat of cymbals and druirs, leonine roars of the elephants and the sounds of the various musical instruments as well as war-cries of the heroes filled with joy.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुरासीत्तदा राजन्सैन्येषु पुरुषर्षभ । योधानां संप्रहृष्टानां तथा समभवत्स्वनः ॥२५॥
तथा प्रहृष्टे सैन्ये तु प्लवमानं महारथम् । विकत्थमानं च तदा राधेयमरिकर्षणम् । मद्रराजः प्रहस्येदं वचनं प्रत्यभाषत ॥२६॥
verses.english: When the Kuru ariny was thus filled with joy the king of Madra said in derision the following words to the subduer of foes, the son of Radha, the powerful car-warrior who was thus bragging and about to plunge himself into that ocean of battle.
